page.title: Predictions
page.description: Call it before it happens. Pick before the lock, see who saw it coming, and climb the season leaderboard.
page.lead: Call it before it happens. Picks close at the lock, and every right call counts on the leaderboard.
page.missing: This prediction doesn't exist, or you can't see it.

empty.open: Nothing open right now. Got a hunch? Make the first call.
empty.locked: Nothing is waiting on a result.

card.lock_now_confirm: Lock picks now? Nobody will be able to pick or change a pick after this.
card.link_copied: Link copied. Paste it on a line of its own in any post to show this prediction there.
card.delete_confirm: Delete this prediction and everyone's picks? This can't be undone.

card.hidden_until_lock: Picks stay hidden until it locks

card.missed: Not this time. On to the next one.
card.settler: You settled this one, so your pick doesn't count.
card.not_counted: This one doesn't count toward the leaderboard: fewer than {count} people picked.
card.needs_pickers: Counts toward the leaderboard once {count} people have picked.
card.voided: This prediction was called off. Nobody gets points for it.

form.title: New prediction
form.question: Question
form.details_placeholder: How it gets decided, the source you'll settle it by…
form.options_locked: Someone has already picked, so the kind and the choices can't change.
form.tolerance_help: The closest guess always counts as a hit. Set a range to count every guess that close as a hit too.
form.lock_help: In your own time zone. Nobody can pick or change a pick after this.
form.hide_picks_help: Nobody sees how others picked, or the totals, until then. No following the crowd.
form.wording_locked: Others have picked, so the question and hidden picks can only be changed by a moderator.

settle.title: Settle it
settle.own_pick: Your own pick on this one won't count, since you're settling it.
settle.correcting: Settling again corrects the result. Everyone's points are worked out again. (Moderators only.)
settle.void: Call it off instead (no points for anyone)
settle.void_confirm: Call this prediction off? Nobody gets points for it.
settle.done: Settled. Everyone who picked has been told how they did.

single.hidden: Picks stay hidden until it locks.

board.how_choice_bold: A right call is worth 10 points, plus up to 10 more for a bold one: the fewer people who saw it coming, the more it's worth.
board.how_choice: A right call is worth 10 points.
board.how_number: Closest number: the nearest guess (ties too) scores 20. If the prediction has a range, every other guess inside it scores 5 to 10.
board.how_rank: Ranked by points. Your hit rate is how many of your settled picks you called right. A prediction counts once 3 people besides whoever settles it have picked.
board.empty: Nobody has scored this season yet. Pick on an open prediction to get on the board.

notification.missed: A prediction you picked was settled
notification.locked: Your prediction locked. Time to settle it.
notification.preference_called: Someone settles a prediction I called right
notification.preference_missed: Someone settles a prediction I picked wrong
notification.preference_locked: A prediction I made locks and needs settling

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.predictions_locked: Picks are locked on this one.
errors.predictions_bad_description: The details can be up to 1,000 characters.
errors.predictions_bad_options: Give 2 to 12 different choices, each up to 80 characters.
errors.predictions_bad_lock: The lock time has to be in the future, and no more than two years away.
errors.predictions_bad_unit: The unit can be up to 24 characters.
errors.predictions_bad_tolerance: The range has to be a number, zero or more.
errors.predictions_bad_discussion: You can only add a prediction to your own discussion.
errors.predictions_frozen: Others have picked, so only a moderator can change the question or whether picks are hidden.
errors.predictions_season_over: This prediction was settled in a season that has ended, so its result can't change.
errors.predictions_lock_later: Others have picked, so the lock can only move earlier. A moderator can move it later.
errors.predictions_has_picks: Someone has already picked, so the choices can't change.
errors.predictions_slow_down: You've opened a lot of predictions today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.predictions_not_found: This prediction doesn't exist, or you can't see it.
errors.predictions_bad_season: Give the new season a name (up to 80 characters).

settings.bold_bonus_help: A right call is worth 10 points, plus up to 10 more the fewer people saw it coming. Off, every right call is worth 10.
settings.oracle_count_help: How many top predictors become Oracles when you end a season. 0 names none.
settings.oracle_group_help: The season's Oracles join this group, and last season's leave it (members you added by hand stay).
settings.oracle_badge_help: An "Oracle" badge from FoF Badges, kept for good. Made the first time; rename or recolor it in FoF Badges.

season.no_leaders: Nobody has scored this season yet.
season.end_help: The season's top predictors become its Oracles, and the leaderboard starts fresh. Past seasons stay on the leaderboard.
season.confirm: End the season now? Its top predictors become Oracles and the leaderboard starts fresh.
